verdict.rationale: RealtimeKit documents delivering signed meeting, participant, and recording events to your backend, which matches webhook-style outbound event subscription. The evidence is a single thin line and never explicitly describes registering HTTP callback endpoints. missing for 10: explicit webhook registration/configuration docs, event catalog and payload schema, delivery/retry semantics, signature verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
